messages:
anya: ClearPath wants a co-sell sandbox next month. Ask: partner API keys, quick pricing table, and a legal-lite pilot addendum. Can we assemble?

matt (ClearPath): Hi! Sandbox needs SSO support + 100k embeddings/day quota for pilot. Also need a short note about data retention and logs.

rafa: We can provide a time-limited partner key + entitlement code. We'll include sample CLI: 
```
redwood-cli partner create-key --partner clearpath --entitlement ENT-CP-PILOT --ttl 30d
```

min: Pricing note: propose Hosted pilot rates with partner discount. I'll draft a one-line cheat sheet: embeddings/unit price, gen token price, estimated monthly example for 100k embeddings/day.

matt (ClearPath): Also legal asks: 1-page addendum for pilot that covers data handling (retain logs 90 days), pilot term 30 days, and liability cap. Need it by Thu EOD.

anya: Owners: entitlements & key flow: rafa; pricing cheat sheet: min; pilot addendum draft: anya (I'll loop legal). Can finance do quick margin calc?

finance-bot: Please fill billing ticket PT-778 with partner margin % and pilot discount to generate invoice lines.

min: I'll suggest 15% partner margin, 20% pilot discount. Rafa, include TTL and telemetry labels in the key response.

rafa: Done. Also adding network note: allow hostnames api.redwood.ai and cdn.redwood.ai for sandbox. IPs may change.

matt (ClearPath): Great. We'll send SSO metadata by tomorrow. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

anya: I'll post the draft addendum and cheat sheet to the shared drive and ping for review by Wed. Sync Fri 9am PT if needed. :thumbsup:
